findings.claim: The new `deleteMany` uses `OR` with one branch scoped to `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS` and a second branch that matches any row with `retryCount > 1`. As written, any workflow reminder of any method will be deleted after two retries, even though this endpoint is intended to manage SMS reminders only. This can silently remove email or other reminders once they accumulate retries.
findings.title: Retry cleanup deletes reminders from other delivery methods
